feeds.title: First2Care Blog
feeds.description: First2Care provides transparent NDIS Plan Management & is focused on supporting your choices. We are an independent NDIS Plan Manager, helping our participants realize their goals. We empower you to take control of your plan through our personalized support service and easy-to-use portal. Live the life you want while we take care of your NDIS plan administration.

feeds.title: Like Family Blog
feeds.description: Read stories, thoughts & ideas about the aged and disability care sector from Like Family.

feeds.title: The SALT Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2011, The SALT Foundation is a not-for-profit organization providing programs that promote a state of physical, social, and mental well-being for people, families, and communities. We have been working in the NDIS almost since its inception and have identified the need for quality Support Workers who can provide care and compassion to our participants.

feeds.title: Classy Life
feeds.description: With a vision of creating a more inclusive life for people with profound disability, Classy Life is committed to creating a positive impact in the Disability Services sector. Classy Life provides culturally safe and sensitive services for people from various ethnic backgrounds. Classy Life is a Registered NDIS Provider in Central Coast, Newcastle, Central Coast, Sydney committed to providing the NDIS disability service in SIL, Community Participation & more all over NSW.

feeds.title: LifeFul Blog
feeds.description: Our purpose is to listen, understand & challenge our clients to live the best life they are capable of, by optimizing their plans and finding the best pathways to their chosen outcomes, giving voice to those unable to speak and skills and confidence to those who can. Find out all sorts of interesting facts and stories on our blog page.

feeds.title: Activ Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1951, Activ was formed by a group of families who wanted more for their children who lived with disability and had become marginalized by society. We focus on enabling and supporting people with disability in their transition towards independence. We believe independence is the freedom to make choices about your own life and take responsibility for those decisions.

feeds.title: South Eastern Wellbeing Assistance Blog
feeds.description: South Eastern Wellbeing Assistance Pty Ltd an NDIS Registered Service Provider in Victoria has been established in Melbourne in response to the demand for service support to Melbournians with the disability. We appreciate our NDIS participants and their families for their trust that provides us with this opportunity to deliver services to them.

feeds.title: Integrity Disability Hub Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news and advice from our team of experts, including NDIS information for people with disabilities. At Integrity Disability, we are your specialists in the NDIS. Our team of Disability Support Workers and NDIS Plan Managers is passionately driven to assist people living with disabilities in reaching their objectives and improving their quality of life.

feeds.title: NDIS - Cases and Commentary
feeds.description: A blog for Administrative Appeals Tribunal cases involving the National Disability Insurance Scheme

feeds.title: Cocoon SDA Care Blog
feeds.description: Cocoon SDA Care is a leading, specialist disability accommodation (SDA) and personalized care/support services registered National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) provider. Our services provide independence, safety, security, improved quality of life, and peace of mind for our residents. Our mission is to provide high-quality professional care and specialist disability accommodation and support services without compromise to meet the individual needs of Australians with a disability who are participants of the NDIS.

feeds.title: Premium Disability Support Services Blog
feeds.description: Premium Disability Support Services is an NDIS (National Disability Insurance Scheme) Service Provider based in Melbourne. We provide disability support services all across Melbourne. We support all individuals with disabilities to develop the skills and capabilities that they require to achieve independence and participate in society. We are extremely passionate about extending the best quality support and services that have been personalised according to your goals and aspirations.

feeds.title: Australian National Care Blog
feeds.description: Thinking NDIS. Think Australian National Care.

feeds.title: Acacia Plan Management Blog
feeds.description: We are a group of professional, friendly, and passionate individuals with over five combined decades of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, social work, mental health, and most recently, working with the NDIS and its systems and processes. Our vision is to set the standard of how plan management should be administered to allow clients to meet their NDIS needs.

feeds.title: Provider+ Blog
feeds.description: Provider+ was founded in 2017 as the NDIS was being rolled out across Australia, changing the face of disability services. It has now helped thousands of NDIS providers reach their goals and grow their businesses. We're committed to helping the NDIS marketplace thrive, that's why our purpose is to give you 'The Freedom to Care'.

feeds.title: Concept Care Blog
feeds.description: Concept Care is one of the fastest-growing NDIS Registered Providers and has been established as a trusted provider of choice. As a leading NDIS Registered Service Provider in Sydney, we are deeply committed to providing the industry benchmark in care support services to the aging population and those with a disability or injury.

feeds.title: My Plan Manager Blog
feeds.description: We are the largest and one of Australia's first plan management services. Our team of experts has the experience and know-how to help you get the most out of your NDIS Plan. Our mission is to create an inclusive Australia where everyone has the opportunity to reach their full potential. We work to drive much-needed changes in attitudes around disability through policymakers, the media, and in the community.

feeds.title: Aastha Community Services Blog
feeds.description: Aastha Community Services(ACS) is a registered NDIS provider, delivering NDIS support services across Western Australia. Aastha delivers support and services which enable NDIS participants to achieve their goals and lead an independent life. We uphold the rights of people with disabilities to enhance their social and economic participation and thereby ensuring their inclusion in the wider community.
